facts.status_note: Listed as removed by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source describes the site now.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wikipedia calls the summit Sleepy Cat Peak; the lookout sources say Sleepy Cat Mountain. Their coordinates agree to within about 20 metres, so both names are treated as one summit.

notes_for_editor: The 1913, 1914 and 1919 items are quoted second-hand on the Forest Lookouts page; the original newspapers were not checked. The FFLA gives Tower Removed with no date, so no removal event is recorded. The brief height of 9.1 m matches the 30-foot figure in the 1919 item. Wikipedia coordinates 40.127477, -107.5336727 sit about 20 m from the FFLA point. The Colorado Fire Lookout Tower Collection PDF (Mss.02651) returned no text. No access source was found; this is not a climbable-site record and should not be used to encourage an ascent.
